description: This file defines data models, query parameter classes, and a fetcher class for Benzinga Price Target data, including methods for transforming queries, extracting data from the Benzinga API, and processing the data into structured models.

classes.name: BenzingaPriceTargetQueryParams
classes.description: Class for specifying query parameters for Benzinga Price Target API requests, including validation and conversion methods.

classes.name: BenzingaPriceTargetData
classes.description: Data model representing individual Benzinga Price Target data entries.

classes.name: BenzingaPriceTargetFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for retrieving and processing Benzinga Price Target data from the API.

methods.name: convert_action
methods.description: Converts action string to standardized format using COVERAGE_DICT.

methods.name: date_validate
methods.description: Converts date or datetime to Unix timestamp.

methods.name: convert_list
methods.description: Converts list of strings or a string into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: parse_date
methods.description: Parses published date string into date object.

methods.name: validate_date
methods.description: Converts Unix timestamp to datetime or date object.

methods.name: replace_empty_strings
methods.description: Replaces empty string values with None in data dictionaries.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms a dictionary of parameters into a BenzingaPriceTargetQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
